plan: Boost + rotation (surge exit, whipsaw switch (the whole account into TLT or GLD) with the rate/gold regime, TLT / GLD by 6-month gain, narrow-market cash week read from the equal-weight index’s full history, lower-high exit into gold or bonds on both its triggers, no T-bills: gold or bonds if up over 3 months, else DBMF managed futures (from its start in May 2019; cash before); price-break rule: the day SPY closes under its 100-day average for the first time with that average and its 7-day average both falling, the haven pick for 10 sessions; buy freeze: no new stocks for 10 sessions after a week ends with SPY within 1% of a weekly lower high that the daily chart confirms, an empty slot in the haven pick; green light: weekly and daily higher lows lift the buy filters and skip the cash week for 10 sessions; rebound rule: stays in stocks after a 12%+ drop with gold or bonds up 2%+ and a daily higher low; break re-entry rule: after a 10%+ drop, a weekly and a daily downtrend break (the daily one on fading volume) within 21 sessions hold stocks for 21 sessions; fading-energy filter: a top-5 stock whose volume and daily swings have both faded isn’t bought, its slot stays in cash; the whipsaw check counts the list with the filter off)
previous: the same plan with SPY as a third whipsaw-switch choice (default until Oct 28, 2026)
source: From the audit’s daily curves: stocks in the S&P 500 at the time, from the real daily member lists (since Oct 26, 2026; before, lists rebuilt from Wikipedia’s change table held companies years before they joined), with prices for former members from Tiingo; 0.15% slippage, 37%/20% tax; Sharpe and Sortino net of a 2% cash rate.
